cipher.name: Base10AsciiShift
cipher.idea: To ensure perfect implementation correctness and high model reasoning capability, we shift the ASCII value of each character by a fixed offset. Every character (including letters, digits, spaces, and punctuation) is shifted forward by 3 in the ASCII table. This is completely symmetric, extremely simple to implement, and preserves the structure of the text while entirely changing the characters to bypass simple keyword filters.
cipher.encrypt_rules: For each character in the plaintext, find its ASCII code, add 3 to it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: encrypt(char) = chr(ord(char) + 3)
cipher.decrypt_rules: For each character in the ciphertext, find its ASCII code, subtract 3 from it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: decrypt(char) = chr(ord(char) - 3)
